children: KAITO has a supply unlock scheduled for February 2027. The unlock covers up to 32.6 million tokens, equal to 13.51% of the circulating supply before the event. It includes allocations for the community, ecosystem, foundation, investors, liquidity, and team.

As the tokens enter circulation, recipients can sell tokens they could not sell while those allocations were locked. If recipients sell part of their allocations, the added supply can put downward pressure on the token's price.

title: KAITO: Supply unlock releases up to 32.6 million tokens - Feb 2027
